meta.name: HAX skeletons
meta.about: 13 starter sites shipped with HAXcms (from haxcms-nodejs, branch skeleton-names), the use case each serves and the theme each starts from.

kindLabels.rel: skeleton to use case and theme

k_academic.desc: A research group or scholar site on the al-folio theme: about, publications by year, projects, teaching, people and contact, shown with a sample coastal ecology lab.
k_academic.note: Machine name academic; theme al-folio-theme; tags academic, research, publications, lab.

k_art_portfolio.desc: An artist portfolio on the Clean Portfolio theme: artist statement, featured works, two series and a contact page for commissions.
k_art_portfolio.note: Machine name art-portfolio; theme clean-portfolio-theme; tags art, gallery, portfolio.

k_blog.desc: A blog starter on the Clean One theme: posts, a journal, topic pages, about and contact, shown with a sample coffee blog.
k_blog.note: Machine name blog; theme clean-one; tags blog, journal, writing.

k_club_website.desc: A website for a student club or organization on the Polaris Flex theme: about, events, a blog and a way to join, shown with a sample book club.
k_club_website.note: Machine name club-website; theme polaris-flex-theme; tags club, organization, community.

k_default_starter.desc: Simple starter site with one page to get you started
k_default_starter.note: Machine name default-starter; theme clean-two; tags default.

k_department.desc: A website for a university department, office or center on the Polaris Flex Sidebar theme: about, services, people, news, contact and a privacy page, shown with a sample learning design office.
k_department.note: Machine name department; theme polaris-flex-sidebar; tags department, office, organization, university.

k_docs.desc: A documentation site on the HAXma theme, shown documenting the HAX command line tool (HAX create).
k_docs.note: Machine name docs; theme haxma-theme; tags docs, developer, reference.

k_isc_graduate_portfolio.desc: A graduate competency portfolio on the Clean Portfolio theme: About Me, Competencies, three domains, Specialization and Publications.
k_isc_graduate_portfolio.note: Machine name isc-graduate-portfolio; theme clean-portfolio-theme; tags portfolio, graduate, competencies.

k_landing_page.desc: A landing page for a small business or product on the AstroWind theme: a home page that sells, services, pricing, about, contact and a privacy page, shown with a sample bike repair shop.
k_landing_page.note: Machine name landing-page; theme astrowind-theme; tags landing, business, marketing, services.

k_online_course.desc: An online course on the Clean One theme, shown as a short orientation lesson that teaches learners how to find their way around a HAX site and edit a page.
k_online_course.note: Machine name online-course; theme clean-one; tags online, lesson, orientation.

k_portfolio.desc: A professional portfolio on the Glossy Portfolio theme: summary, projects, experience, education and certifications, and contact.
k_portfolio.note: Machine name portfolio; theme glossy-portfolio-theme; tags portfolio, career, professional.

k_resume_journey.desc: A resume told as a journey on the Journey theme: education, experience, projects, skills and a way to reach out.
k_resume_journey.note: Machine name resume-journey; theme journey-theme; tags resume, career, skills.

k_writing.desc: A writing-only site on the Writing theme: a home page of recent posts, an About page, a Contact page, an archive by year, and posts under Posts.
k_writing.note: Machine name writing; theme writing-theme; tags blog, writing, posts, minimal.

blog.desc: Blogs and journals on HAXcms, like btopro.com, written in the same editor as courses.

docs.desc: Project documentation sites; haxtheweb.org's docs are being rebuilt as Learn HAX.

club.desc: A website for a student club or group.

tours.label: Start a site from a skeleton
tours.message: The 13 skeletons HAXcms ships, the use case each serves and the theme each starts from.

scenes.caption: A skeleton is a full working site you can start from and hand to someone else.
Courses, portfolios, a blog, docs, a club site and a plain starter.
Each one serves a use case.
Each one starts from a theme; open Themes to see them.
The CLI creates sites from skeletons; Winston built the templating.
Skeletons, use cases and themes together.
